name: io.kendor/docs
title: Kendor Docs
description: Search and read the Kendor docs: coding screens, live coding, AI agents, repo import. No sign-in.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find Kendor documentation pages that answer a question, such as "let candidates use Claude Code", "import a private repository" or "add a Postgres database". Returns up to 5 pages, each with its URL, path and a matching passage.

query.description: The question or topic, in plain words

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Returns one Kendor docs page as markdown, by its path or kendor.io docs URL, for example "/docs/ai-agents/turn-on-claude-code-and-codex".

page.description: Docs path or kendor.io docs URL

language.description: Docs language; defaults to the URL’s language, else English
